title: Prospective multi-pathogen disease forecasting using autonomous LLM-guided tree search
abstract: arXiv:2605.16238v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting of infectious diseases is crucial for public health monitoring and preparedness but has historically relied on labor-intensive manual model curation by expert modeling teams. Bespoke development is an obstacle to scaling models to granular geographic resolutions or emerging pathogens. Here, we prospectively evaluate Empirical Research Assistance (ERA), an autonomous system that uses Large Language Model-guided tree search to iteratively generate, evaluate, and optimize executable forecasting software. ERA was primarily prompted with methodological approaches to implement, while in some instances it was tasked with developing forecasting approaches from scratch. In a fully prospective, real-time evaluation during the 2025-26 United States respiratory season, ERA generated methodologically diverse models for influenza, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). translated_title: 使用自主LLM引导的树搜索进行前瞻性多病原体疾病预测
translated_abstract: 传染病的概率预测对公共卫生监测和防范准备至关重要，但历史上一直依赖于专家建模团队进行的劳动密集型人工模型构建。定制化开发是将模型扩展至精细地理分辨率或新兴病原体的障碍。在此，我们前瞻性地评估了实证研究辅助系统，这是一个利用大语言模型引导的树搜索来迭代生成、评估和优化可执行预测软件的自主系统。ERA主要通过提示需要实现的方法学方法来运行，而在某些情况下，它被要求从头开始开发预测方法。在2025-26年美国呼吸系统疾病流行季期间的一项完全前瞻性的实时评估中，ERA为流感、COVID-19和呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）生成了方法学上多样化的模型。通过聚合其中一部分自动化模型……
tldr: 本研究前瞻性评估了名为ERA的自主系统，它利用大语言模型引导的树搜索自动生成、评估和优化可执行的疾病预测软件，并在2025-26年美国呼吸季实时为流感、COVID-19和RSV生成了多样化的预测模型。
en_tdlr: The study prospectively evaluates ERA, an autonomous system using LLM-guided tree search to iteratively generate, evaluate, and optimize executable forecasting software, which produced diverse real-time models for influenza, COVID-19, and RSV during the 2025-26 US respiratory season.
